lines: Barkley's workload has grown lately. He played 52% of snaps over his last 3 games, up from 42% on the season.
He's averaged 11.4 PPR points per game over his last 3, mostly on the ground: 14.3 carries per game and only 0.7 targets.
In Wk 12 at DAL, PHI's implied total is 19.5 points, but Dallas allows the 3rd-most PPR points per game to RBs.
